_comment: ExplainTory locked-in voice profile. Reconstructed from the settings recorded
in .claude/skills/explaintory-voiceover/SKILL.md, because the container is not
storage and the copy carried over from Voiceover Studio dies with every session
(see HANDOFF.md, 'The container is not storage'). Committed here so it stops
having to be rebuilt from the skill text every time.
NO API KEY IN THIS FILE. ELEVENLABS_API_KEY lives in the environment.
pronOn is false on purpose: Sapro compared a raw take against a respelled one
and chose the raw. The pronunciation guide is the reference for CHECKING, not

readTitle is FALSE. 2026-08-18, Sapro: "remove the video title from the voiceover that's not allowed in the voiceover". It had been ON as an inherited default that nobody chose — the --plan gate flagged it every run as "1 value(s) nobody chose" and it was read past every time, and a comment in derive_title asserted the spoken title was "the read Sapro has been publishing". It was not. The narration opens on the first chapter name.
